Hm~, the cherry blossoms looked like they were in\nfull bloom from afar, but up close, many of them\nare still buds~.
Things might look different if we go all the way\nup to Leafy Sakura Village...!
Woof woof woof!!
Was that a dog barking~?\nI feel like I heard a girl's voice too, and it\nsounded familiar.
I think it came from this way, right?!
All right, Hayatemaru!\nTime to start your special training!
Heh-heh-heh...
Stop panting like that!\nYou need to take this training more seriously!
I knew it was you, Princess Nanaka!\nHow have you been~?
Oh, it's you and Pelulu!\nLong time no see!
Woof!! Woof woof!!
So, the barking I heard earlier was this fella?\nWhat are you guys doing in a place like this?
His name is Hayatemaru!\nI was training him. It's special training for\nninja dogs!
What are ninja dogs~?
They're special dogs that have undergone ninja\ntraining!
They're strong, both physically and mentally.\nAnd they have great instincts. They would never\nsurrender to their enemies…
Heh-heh-heh...
H-Hayatemaru!\nThat's so embarrassing!
Hm~, I don't see anything special about this dog~.
But he's the only ninja dog in Leafy Sakura\nVillage, and I've been raising him since he was a\npuppy.
Actually, today is a special day for ninja dogs.
A special day~?
Yes...With the cherry blossoms in full bloom\ntoday, any ninja dog that visits the White Peach\nShrine alone will be granted a special honor.
The path to the shrine is steep and fraught with\ndangerous and formidable foes. Any ninja dog that\nsucceeds will be praised by the ruler of the land.
I see~.\nThat's why you did some last-minute special\ntraining~?
Yes...\nI want everyone to see Hayatemaru in a new light\nthis time and acknowledge his capabilities.
But you can't expect people to acknowledge his\ncapabilities if he isn't even trying~.
Right...I've asked for something suitable for\ndogs, like a piece of bone-in meat, if a reward is\nto be given...
What?!\nIf there's gonna be a reward, you should've told\nme earlier!
From now on, we're one~!\nYou have my full support! Roll up your sleeves!
Woof woof!!
Wow, you're so reliable!
Alright, let's head to Mt. White Peach!!\nFollow me!!
So the Mt. White Peach shrine is up ahead?
Yes.\nFrom here, just go straight up the mountain.
Hmm~...\nBut it looks like no one's watching.\nWhy don't we all just help Hayatemaru?
That's impossible.\nSkilled ninjas who serve the ruler are hiding\neverywhere.
I see~.\nThen I guess we'll just have to let Hayatemaru\ntry his best first~.
Yip yip~...
Hayatemaru?!\nBrace yourself! You're a ninja dog, after all!!
Yip~...
Alright, here we go!!
Now, show us what you've got!!
Well, I wonder how long he will take~!
The current best time seems to be around 1 hour.\nEven if he can't top it, it'd still be impressive\nif he can tie the record...
Yelp! Yelp!
...I don't think he can do this. He's even more\ntimid than a normal dog.
What?\nYou got something to say~?
The source of Hayatemaru's energy...
These cherry blossoms lack scent.
The scent of cherry blossoms is the source of\nHayatemaru's energy?\nWait, what do you mean?
You're saying that the scent of the cherry\nblossoms here isn't strong enough~??\nWait, what do you mean?
I see~.\nEven if they appear to be in full bloom to us,\nit's still not enough for Hayatemaru?
What?!
So it's not just about how they look~.
W-well, in that case, I know something that could\nhelp!
I'll go find it right away.\nPlease wait here!
What?\nPrincess Nanaka~?
What is it, Hayatemaru?\nIs something wrong?
Yip~...
By the way, Princess Nanaka has been gone for a\nwhile. I wonder what takes her so long.
Wait, don't tell me you've picked up on something?\nHas something happened to your owner?
Woof woof!
Maybe we should just go and get her~.
But we dunno where she went.\nWe're relying on your nose!\nLead us to your owner!
W-woof!!
